# Diffusers runtime snapshot

Runtime source from https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers at commit
`175fe6b2419a01db9c2ceabd01ec37d2c0305fc2` (0.40.0.dev0), bundled for the
MiniMax-H3 workflow and Wan adapters. The upstream Apache-2.0 LICENSE is included.
This is a source-only subset, not the full upstream repository. See the root
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for packaging scope. PulseQuant launchers select `src/`
through PYTHONPATH; general dependencies must already be installed.
